fields.Appearance: Small, quick, and layered in oversized clothes with several hidden pockets.
fields.Backstory: An orphan earns meals carrying messages and has memorized routes through places adults rarely notice.
fields.Goals: Find a missing friend and turn local knowledge into a secure future.

fields.Appearance: Dusty and watchful, holding a battered cup while quietly studying everyone who passes.
fields.Backstory: A beggar witnessed an important exchange because neither participant considered them worth noticing.
fields.Goals: Trade the information for lasting safety without revealing how much they truly know.

fields.Appearance: Defiant, brightly patched, and marked with the subtle sign of a neighborhood street group.
fields.Backstory: A street child joined a loose gang for protection after authorities cleared their former shelter.
fields.Goals: Keep younger children safe and claim a permanent place no official can casually take away.

fields.Appearance: Ragged but resourceful, carrying wire, string, and useful fragments sorted into careful bundles.
fields.Backstory: A scavenger found a valuable object in discarded belongings linked to a recent disappearance.
fields.Goals: Return the object to the right person and avoid those searching the refuse for it.

fields.Appearance: Recently cleaned but visibly uncomfortable in borrowed clothes that fit too well.
fields.Backstory: A runaway fled an abusive apprenticeship and now fears being legally returned to the former master.
fields.Goals: Prove the abuse, secure independent work, and help other apprentices escape the same treatment.
